headline: Saraf and Partners acts on Fortis - SLJ Society collaboration for super specialty hospital in Ashok Vihar, New Delhi
sum: Fortis Healthcare Limited is collaborating with Seth Sunder Lal Jain Charitable Eye Hospital to provide healthcare and medical services and to facilitate SLJ Society to construct, upgrade and operate a state-of-the-art 400+ bedded super…
detail: Fortis Healthcare Limited is collaborating with Seth Sunder Lal Jain Charitable Eye Hospital to provide healthcare and medical services and to facilitate SLJ Society to construct, upgrade and operate a state-of-the-art 400+ bedded super specialty hospital in Ashok Vihar, New Delhi. The hospital will be owned, operated and managed by SLJ Society, and Fortis will be providing healthcare services to SLJ Society. The land, building and the associated civil and certain medical infrastructure will be owned and developed by the SLJ Society itself. Pursuant to this collaboration, Fortis executed a healthcare services agreement, loan agreement and certain ancillary agreements with SLJ Society.
